content: Lifecycle event ordering: Page Visibility API - transition to hidden is the LAST reliably observable event before teardown; treat hidden as end-of-session for tracking (MDN). Chrome/Firefox/WebKit all fire pagehide BEFORE visibilitychange; visibilitychange:hidden also fires on navigation. Hidden state: rAF paused, timers throttled (Chrome: once/sec then once/min after 5min; Firefox similar budget). Reliable backgrounding detection in WebViews requires: visibilitychange + window focus/blur + pageshow/pagehide + wall-clock (Date.now) delta computation on every resume signal, because visibilitychange is not reliably delivered in WebView unless host wires onPause/onResume (lyrion-dashboard commit). Use Date.now() not performance.now() for hidden-elapsed computation (iOS stops performance.now during sleep).
